findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ontario_list-service · Private data: ontario_purchase_router, ontario_find-api, ontario_base-balances, ontario_base-tx-check, ontario_base-gas, ontario_task_fit, ontario_list-service, ontario_refresh-listing, ontario_list-agent · Public sink: ontario_list-service.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ontario_list-service · Private data: ontario_purchase_router, ontario_find-api, ontario_base-balances, ontario_base-tx-check, ontario_base-gas, ontario_task_fit, ontario_list-service, ontario_refresh-listing, ontario_list-agent · Public sink: ontario_list-service

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
